description: Edit an existing note's title or body. body REPLACES the whole note body unless append=true; pass dryRun=true first to see the current and resulting body length without writing.

body.description: New body. Plain text; newlines become formatted HTML unless html=true.

confirmToken.description: Only after a confirmation_required error: the confirmToken it returned, with the same arguments, to carry out the call.

dryRun.description: Report title, previousBodyLength and newBodyLength without writing.

html.description: Treat body as raw HTML (skip plain-text-to-HTML conversion).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A repeat of this key with the same arguments within 24 hours returns the first result with replayed=true and does nothing.

title: notes_edit: arguments
